name: Party Identification SD 4
definition: Contact person at the party organising the meeting, at the issuer or at an intermediary.

ContactPerson.name: Contact Person
ContactPerson.definition: Identifies a contact person by a name, a given name and an address.

EmployingParty.name: Employing Party
EmployingParty.definition: Identifies the organisation which is represented by a person or for which a person works.
